definitions.explanation: Describes people of Japanese ancestry living abroad, or companies and organizations with Japanese origins or connections.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{日系|にっけい}アメリカ{人|じん}だ。
{日系|にっけい}{企業|きぎょう}がこの{地域|ちいき}に{多|おお}く{進出|しんしゅつ}している。
examples.english: Many Japanese-affiliated companies have expanded into this region.

examples.japanese: ブラジルには{世界|せかい}{最大|さいだい}の{日系|にっけい}{社会|しゃかい}があり、{約|やく}200{万人|まんにん}が{暮|く}らしている。
examples.english: Brazil has the world's largest Japanese-descent community, with about 2 million people living there.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a prefix before nouns to indicate Japanese ancestry or affiliation. Most commonly seen in {日系|にっけい} + nationality (e.g., {日系|にっけい}アメリカ{人|じん}) or {日系|にっけい} + {企業|きぎょう} (Japanese-affiliated company). Part of a broader pattern: {米系|べいけい} (US-affiliated), {中国系|ちゅうごくけい} (Chinese-affiliated), {韓国系|かんこくけい} (Korean-affiliated).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日系|にっけい}アメリカ{人|じん}: Japanese American
- {日系|にっけい}{企業|きぎょう}: Japanese-affiliated company
- {日系|にっけい}{社会|しゃかい}: Japanese-descent community
- {日系|にっけい}{移民|いみん}: Japanese immigrants/emigrants
